test.name: Fuzz instance_path for 10 minutes on this Mac

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run instance_path --time 600 runs the instance_path target with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz and finds no crash, hang, or out of memory.
actual: no crash, hang, or out of memory and fuzz/artifacts/ empty after two runs of 600 s each. First run (committed seeds only): instance_path 1709376 runs in 601 s (2844 exec/s), 330 new units, peak RSS 621 MB, /usr/bin/time 603.47 s real, load average 44 at the start and 45 at the end. Second run (on the corpus the first run grew): 1427446 runs in 601 s, 275 new units, peak RSS 546 MB, 603.45 s real, ran for 600 s without a crash. The head and tail of the first log are in the files folder
steps: on commit d69dd89 (spec 0020 step 16: the instance_path target, its TARGETS row, and 27 seeds) with a clean tree, use the pinned fuzz toolchain nightly-2026-10-17 and cargo-fuzz 0.13.2; `cargo xtask fuzz build instance_path` builds the target with AddressSanitizer (default)
start from the 27 committed seeds only (fuzz/corpus was empty before a 20 second smoke run, which found no crash)

run `/usr/bin/time cargo xtask fuzz run instance_path --time 600` alone, in the background, from 2026-10-22T11:23Z to 11:33Z, while other sessions used the Mac; a second run of the same command followed on the grown corpus
check that each command exits 0 with `ran for 600 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the head and tail of the first log in this record's files folder (the middle NEW, REDUCE, and pulse progress lines are cut)

the fixture tree holds symlinks out of the root, to another root, in a loop, to itself, Unicode and spaced names, and a folder 64 levels deep (fixture_tree), judged by check_owned_path and check_data_root_overlap through owned_path
